title: Accounting and Tax Services for International Students With Businesses

rows.before: Where profit genuinely stays behind in the company, section 125 brings the combined Ontario charge on its first $500,000 of active business income down to roughly 12.2%; where every dollar leaves to live on, you have bought a second return.
rows.after: Where profit genuinely stays behind in the company, section 125 brings the combined Ontario charge on its first $500,000 of active business income down to roughly 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026); where every dollar leaves to live on, you have bought a second return.
rows.note: 12.2% stated as current combined Ontario small business rate; 11.2% from July 1, 2026. First R1 change on page: parenthetical added.
